coordinateSystem: source pixels; x right, y down; z and depth in source pixels
zConvention: z is the front/top face; side walls extend to z-depth
polygonWinding: outer clockwise / positive signed area; holes counterclockwise / negative signed area
contours: Pixel-centre contours simplified by at most 0.65 source pixel; faces use exact region equality, not these side-wall contours.
